coverage_gaps: Only PubMed is authorized, so curated variant resources such as ClinVar, OMIM, and GWAS Catalog are unavailable for independent classification and allele-frequency cross-checking.
Dedicated citation graphs are unavailable; backward and forward citation expansion is approximated with PubMed seed-author searches and may miss connected records.
Preprint servers are unavailable, so recent unreviewed findings through 2024 are not systematically covered.
Proteomics repositories, structural databases, and raw assay datasets are unavailable, limiting independent verification of substrate spectra and structural interpretations.
Trial registries and regulator sources are unavailable, so inhibitor translation, target-engagement trials, and safety actions are outside comprehensive coverage.
PubMed indexing, abstract availability, and publication bias may underrepresent negative mechanistic studies and non-English full-text evidence.
exclusion_criteria: Parkinson disease records that mention LRRK2 only incidentally and provide no genetic, biochemical, substrate, physiological, pathological, or limiting evidence.
Purely computational substrate, variant-pathogenicity, docking, or pathway predictions lacking experimental or human-genetic validation.
Drug-efficacy studies that do not inform LRRK2 target engagement, enzymatic mechanism, substrate phosphorylation, physiological function, or mechanism-limiting toxicity.
Editorials, narrative commentary, news items, and unsourced assertions used as standalone support for a mechanistic claim.
Conference-only records or inaccessible abstracts with insufficient methods and results to classify the relevant evidence.
Non-Parkinson LRRK2 studies lacking direct substrate, enzymatic, structural, or physiological relevance to the requested mechanism.
Duplicate canonical records are excluded from record-level counting after PMID or DOI reconciliation while every query-to-record occurrence is retained.
inclusion_criteria: Records published or available online by 2024-12-31; ambiguous PubMed date roles are checked after retrieval.

Primary human linkage, sequencing, association, penetrance, founder, neuropathology, or genotype-phenotype studies that directly inform LRRK2 causality, risk, protection, or heterogeneity in Parkinson disease.

Primary biochemical or structural studies that directly measure LRRK2 kinase activity, GTP binding or hydrolysis, autophosphorylation, oligomerization, localization, or activation and connect the measurement to a disease-associated variant or disease-relevant state.

Substrate studies that identify a phosphorylation site or direct biochemical interaction and provide at least one orthogonal validation path such as endogenous perturbation, knock-in genetics, inhibitor-sensitive phosphorylation, in vivo tissue, patient-derived cells, or human material.

Cellular and animal studies that test consequences of LRRK2 or Rab phosphorylation for endolysosomal trafficking, Golgi biology, ciliogenesis, autophagy, phagosome biology, neuronal function, or neurodegeneration.
Null, negative, discordant, replication, correction, retraction, incomplete-penetrance, and heterogeneous-pathology evidence relevant to the strength or generality of a proposed mechanism.
All organisms and languages remain eligible at search stage; organism, model, and translation limits are labeled during synthesis.
Reviews and meta-analyses are eligible for terminology expansion, historical orientation, and record discovery, with decision-critical mechanistic claims traced to primary records.

queries.purpose: Recover the paired genetic-discovery anchors and validate LRRK2, dardarin, and PARK8 terminology without narrowing the locator branches.
queries.query: "Mutations in LRRK2 cause autosomal-dominant parkinsonism with pleomorphic pathology"[Title] OR "Cloning of the gene containing mutations that cause PARK8-linked Parkinson's disease"[Title]

queries.purpose: Recover an early variant-to-kinase-activity anchor for subsequent assay and replication tracing.
queries.query: "Parkinson's disease-associated mutations in leucine-rich repeat kinase 2 augment kinase activity"[Title]

queries.purpose: Recover the phosphoproteomic Rab-substrate anchor and validate substrate nomenclature.
queries.query: "Phosphoproteomics reveals that Parkinson's disease kinase LRRK2 regulates a subset of Rab GTPases"[Title]

queries.purpose: Discover the chronology from PARK8 linkage and cloning through pathogenic alleles, population risk or protective alleles, penetrance estimates, and genotype-pathology associations while preserving the original question wording as a branch.
queries.query: (("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease/genetics"[MeSH Terms] OR parkinson*[Title/Abstract]) AND (linkage[Title/Abstract] OR pedigree*[Title/Abstract] OR cloning[Title/Abstract] OR sequencing[Title/Abstract] OR mutation*[Title/Abstract] OR penetrance[Title/Abstract] OR founder[Title/Abstract] OR "genome-wide association"[Title/Abstract] OR GWAS[Title/Abstract])) OR "relationship between leucine-rich repeat kinase 2 and Parkinson disease"[Title/Abstract]

queries.purpose: Map the enzymatic and structural mechanism across kinase-domain and ROC-COR variants, including direction and context of activity changes.
queries.query: ("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND (kinase[Title/Abstract] OR "ROC GTPase"[Title/Abstract] OR "GTP binding"[Title/Abstract] OR "GTP hydrolysis"[Title/Abstract] OR COR[Title/Abstract] OR dimer*[Title/Abstract] OR autophosphorylation[Title/Abstract] OR activat*[Title/Abstract] OR structure*[Title/Abstract]) AND (variant*[Title/Abstract] OR mutation*[Title/Abstract] OR G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract] OR R1441G[Title/Abstract] OR R1441H[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract] OR N1437H[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Discover proposed direct substrates and the physiological membrane-trafficking processes connected to their phosphorylation.
queries.query: ("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND (substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphoproteom*[Title/Abstract] OR "Rab GTPase"[Title/Abstract] OR Rab8A[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR Rab12[Title/Abstract] OR Rab29[Title/Abstract] OR RAB7L1[Title/Abstract] OR Rab35[Title/Abstract] OR Rab43[Title/Abstract]) AND (phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract] OR trafficking[Title/Abstract] OR lysosom*[Title/Abstract] OR Golgi[Title/Abstract] OR ciliogenesis[Title/Abstract] OR autophag*[Title/Abstract] OR phagosome*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm variant-specific functional direction and magnitude, separating evidence for pathogenic, risk, and protective alleles.
queries.query: ("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract] OR R1441G[Title/Abstract] OR R1441H[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract] OR N1437H[Title/Abstract] OR G2385R[Title/Abstract] OR R1628P[Title/Abstract] OR R1398H[Title/Abstract] OR N551K[Title/Abstract]) AND ("kinase activity"[Title/Abstract] OR "GTPase activity"[Title/Abstract] OR "GTP binding"[Title/Abstract] OR "GTP hydrolysis"[Title/Abstract] OR autophosphorylation[Title/Abstract] OR dimerization[Title/Abstract] OR localization[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm physiological substrate status through endogenous-site phosphorylation, genetic perturbation, in vivo validation, patient-derived material, or human-tissue evidence.
queries.query: ("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND (Rab8A[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR Rab12[Title/Abstract] OR Rab29[Title/Abstract] OR RAB7L1[Title/Abstract] OR Rab35[Title/Abstract] OR Rab43[Title/Abstract]) AND (endogenous[Title/Abstract] OR "knock-in"[Title/Abstract] OR "in vivo"[Title/Abstract] OR "patient-derived"[Title/Abstract] OR "human brain"[Title/Abstract] OR biomarker*[Title/Abstract]) AND (phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Use discovery and early-mechanism seed authors as a PubMed-available proxy expansion to find related primary records and terminology missed by broad branches.
queries.query: (Zimprich A[Author] OR Paisan-Ruiz C[Author] OR West AB[Author]) AND (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Expand from the substrate anchor toward follow-up validation, additional Rab targets, and physiological consequences; compare new decision-relevant records with Q09 for saturation.
queries.query: (Steger M[Author] OR Mann M[Author]) AND (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR Rab[Title/Abstract]) AND (phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphoproteom*[Title/Abstract] OR ciliogenesis[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve counterevidence limiting penetrance, neuropathological uniformity, enzymatic generality, substrate interpretation, model validity, and publication integrity.
queries.query: ("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND (parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR "Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms]) AND (negative[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract] OR unchanged[Title/Abstract] OR discordant[Title/Abstract] OR "failed replication"[Title/Abstract] OR "incomplete penetrance"[Title/Abstract] OR "pleomorphic pathology"[Title/Abstract] OR "without Lewy bodies"[Title/Abstract] OR "no neurodegeneration"[Title/Abstract] OR "kinase-independent"[Title/Abstract] OR "context-dependent"[Title/Abstract] OR "off-target"[Title/Abstract] OR "Retraction of Publication"[Publication Type] OR "Retracted Publication"[Publication Type] OR "Published Erratum"[Publication Type])

queries.purpose: Capture recent genetic, structural, substrate, and mechanistic updates through the delivery cutoff; apply the exact 2024-12-31 cutoff again during screening for online-first and correction-date ambiguity.
queries.query: ("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND (parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR "Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms]) AND (genetic*[Title/Abstract] OR variant*[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract] OR GTPase[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR Rab[Title/Abstract] OR phosphoproteom*[Title/Abstract] OR structure*[Title/Abstract]) AND ("2020/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Target-mechanism frame: For inherited, familial, sporadic, and population-level Parkinson disease, trace how LRRK2/PARK8/dardarin genetics established causal or risk relationships; determine how disease-associated variants alter kinase, ROC GTPase, COR-domain, dimerization, localization, and activation mechanisms; identify directly phosphorylated physiological substrates and downstream trafficking phenotypes; and retain incomplete penetrance, pathological heterogeneity, assay dependence, null findings, and model limitations that constrain causal strength or generality. Search scope is PubMed from database inception through 2024-12-31, with no search-stage language restriction, covering human genetics and neuropathology plus biochemical, structural, cellular, animal, patient-derived, and human-tissue evidence. Reviews may support terminology and record discovery, while mechanistic claims require tracing to primary studies.
stop_rules: Complete all planned PubMed events up to the fixed 12-query budget, preserving exact query strings, execution metadata, result counts, and query-to-record links.

Recover the genetic-discovery, early kinase-activity, and Rab-phosphoproteomics sentinel titles; if an anchor is absent, expand its target aliases before screening and report unresolved recovery failure.

Reach genetic coverage of initial linkage and cloning, major high-penetrance pathogenic variants, population risk or protective variants, penetrance, founder effects, and genotype-pathology heterogeneity.
Reach mechanism coverage of kinase and ROC-COR functions, GTP binding or hydrolysis, dimerization or localization, structural activation, and variant-specific agreement or discordance.

For each substrate retained as physiological, obtain direct site-level evidence plus at least one endogenous, genetic, in vivo, patient-derived, or human validation layer; label candidates lacking this layer as provisional.
Stop expansion when Q09 and Q10 consecutively add no new decision-relevant genetic, mechanistic, substrate, or counterevidence category after canonical deduplication.

Complete the challenge wave and retain evidence for incomplete penetrance, pleomorphic or Lewy-body-negative pathology, mild or absent neurodegeneration in models, assay dependence, null effects, corrections, and retractions when found.
Check every included record against the 2024-12-31 cutoff, distinguishing online-first, issue, and correction dates where PubMed metadata permits.
Stop when additional retrieval within the authorized route cannot change the brief's causal-strength assessment; document remaining uncertainty and all unavailable source classes.
If the query budget is exhausted before anchor or evidence-category saturation, stop deterministically and report budget exhaustion in coverage gaps rather than silently extending the plan.
